Interview & Assessment Platform

A full-stack recruitment and interview management platform developed for Swapnopuron Welfare Society. It brings candidate applications and interviewer workflows together using a React and TypeScript frontend, FastAPI services and PostgreSQL-backed records.

  • Implemented 2 core user journeys: candidate application and interviewer dashboard.
  • Built authenticated REST API workflows with JWT authentication and role-based access control.
  • Connected the application flow to PostgreSQL-backed records and deployed the frontend and backend on Render.
  • Validated the complete candidate journey with 1 test candidate applying to an open Software Developer opportunity.
5Core workflow areas
1Open opportunity in dashboard snapshot
3Applications in dashboard snapshot
2Interviews scheduled in dashboard snapshot

The dashboard counts are the visible demonstration snapshot, not audited organisation-wide hiring results. The platform's business value is centralised pipeline visibility and more structured hand-offs; time savings and hiring improvements have not yet been measured.

MF Facts RAG — Facts-Only Mutual Fund Assistant

A retrieval-grounded, facts-only mutual fund assistant covering 5 HDFC Mutual Fund schemes. It answers factual questions using official source material rather than generating investment advice or return predictions.

  • Grounds answers in official HDFC Mutual Fund, SEBI and AMFI sources, with source links and update dates.
  • Implemented document chunking, embeddings, ChromaDB retrieval and reranking.
  • Integrated Groq-powered responses with guardrails against investment advice and return predictions.

Swapnopuron Education Intelligence

An education intelligence dashboard developed for Swapnopuron using programme records. It consolidates student profiles, attendance, academic performance and branch-level reporting to support programme monitoring and review.

GitHub repository↗
  • Analysed 1,000 student profiles, 12,000 attendance records and 9,000 academic records across 5 branches.
  • Built a 3-page Power BI dashboard covering executive KPIs, attendance trends, branch comparisons, subject performance and learning progression.
  • Dashboard snapshot: 81.62% average attendance, 75.26 average final score and 178 students needing attention. These are descriptive dataset indicators, not measured programme improvements.
